messages:
pm_alex: Quick one — can we move next week's cross-func roadmap + triage from Thu to Wed 10am? Conflicts for a few PMs and one infra deploy.
eng_ryan: Wed 10am would work for eng side. Are we losing any execs?
julia_design: I can do Wed. Will need until Monday EOD to update the RFC slides.
lena_infra: Wed morning is fine but our infra deploy window is Tue night -> Wed 9am, so +1 hr buffer would be ideal. Wed 11am?
omar_sre: @lena_infra we should be done by 9, but we might still be validating. Wed 10 is OK from SRE.
pm_alex: Hmm ok tradeoff. @eng_ryan can you own the agenda if we shift to Wed 10 so infra validation can call out any risks early?
eng_ryan: Yep, I can own agenda. I'll add a 10:00–10:05 opening, then 10:05–10:25 roadmap items, 10:25–10:40 RFC review (Julia), 10:40–10:55 triage/priorities, 10:55–11:00 actions/decisions.
julia_design: Thanks — will trim slides to 10 mins. Posting the RFC link in a sec.
ops_bot: Meeting poll: Wed 10:00 (thumbsup) / Wed 11:00 (thumbsdown) / Thu 10:00 (eyes). React with :thumbsup:, :thumbsdown:, or :eyes: to vote.
pm_alex: Quick agenda template (copy into meeting doc):
```
- Owner: @eng_ryan
- Context: 2–3 bullets from each team
- RFC review: presenter + acceptance criteria
- Triage: unblockers + escalation items
- Decisions & owners: add to decision log with links
```
eng_ryan: Adding agenda to the RFC doc: https://docs.internal/rfcs/infra-cache-2026 — will call on Julia for slide 3.
julia_design: RFC link looks good. I'll flag the 2 acceptance criteria we want sign-off on.
lena_infra: I'll add a line in the decision log after the meeting. Where do we track it? Is it the product decision log or infra one?
pm_alex: Product decision log (canonical). Please add under /decisions with a short summary + link to infra ticket.
oln: (typo) sorry ignore
omar_sre: If we move, can we confirm a dry-run for the infra change preview on Tue 8pm? I'll ping the oncall.
lena_infra: Yep I'll start the dry-run Tuesday 8pm and ping here when done.
eng_ryan: Looks like Wed 10 wins so far. Can folks react to the poll? If no objections by Monday 12pm, I'll lock it and publish calendar invite with agenda.
pm_alex: Decision: shift to Wed 10am if majority react :thumbsup: by Mon 12pm. @julia_design please attach the slide PDF to the invite when ready.
julia_design: Will do.
ops_bot: Reminder set: poll closes Mon 12:00 UTC.
eng_ryan: Also quick ask — can someone call out the top 3 priority disputes so we can slot them in the triage block? I'll seed one: ads model quant rollout vs low-latency routing config.
pm_alex: I'll add two more in the doc: 1) embed infra cost allocation 2) dedicated pool rollout timeline.
lena_infra: Noted.
omar_sre: If we need a follow-up deep-dive, let's schedule a separate 45m. Triage should only surface and assign owners.
pm_alex: Agreed. Final note: agenda owner = @eng_ryan, slide owner = @julia_design, decision log owner after meeting = @lena_infra. I'll update the meeting doc with owner tags now. :white_check_mark:
